text.en:
The sum, of Seven Hundred Fifty Million Pesos is hereby appropriated for the relief and
rehabilitation of people and areas affected by typhoon "Didang", to be spent beginning July 1, 1976 until
exhausted: Provided, That the amounts to be actually committed for expenditure shall not exceed budgetary
savings generated during Fiscal Year 1976.

The President of the Philippines shall determine the projects and activities which shall be
supported from the appropriation authorized herein.

This Decree shall take effect July 1, 1976.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
